verdict.rationale:
First-party docs explicitly state skills are markdown files under skills/ that are 'harness-agnostic' and 'shared verbatim by every harness' (docs-13), with cross-runtime aliasing (docs-31) and a porting guide showing skill files are never rewritten per harness (docs-37). A runtime probe independently confirms skills install as plain, copyable SKILL.md files with readable frontmatter (probe-rt-1), corroborating the plain-markdown, non-proprietary claim.

missing for 10: independent community confirmation of manually copying skill folders between harnesses (only vendor docs and one probe address this), and no discussion of any format lock-in edge cases from users.
